research_question: Does the existing 3-day Gold Control information universe contain any causal-chronology-preserving feature block whose discriminative skill is stable across multiple pre-2025 temporal environments and transports into a 2024Q4 bridge period before 2025/2026 are inspected diagnostically?
literature_basis: Invariant prediction / causal transfer: stable conditional predictive relationships across environments may generalize better under distribution shift.
Maximin/stable effects: shared effects across heterogeneous environments are preferable to effects dominated by one regime.
Time-series OOD generalization: environment construction and temporal adjacency matter; invariant learning can fail when core variables are unobserved or environments are poorly specified.
Structural-break forecasting: hard break detection is not automatically optimal; robust weighting and stable predictors should be evaluated before escalating adaptation.

source_artifact.immutability: Use the frozen V1.64 panel only. No external data fetch and no post-score feature creation are allowed.

target.definition: y_t = 1[close_{t+3} > close_t] using the next three rows of the frozen NY17 panel
target.maturity_rule: A target is usable for training/benchmark history only after its target_date is strictly earlier than the current forecast origin_date.
target.boundary_rule: For an environment score, target_date must lie inside that same environment.

chronological_environment_design.forward_rule: For E1/E2/E3, fit each block using all valid rows strictly before the test environment start and score only the next environment. No future-environment training is allowed.

benchmark.name: CAUSAL_EXPANDING_FREQUENCY
benchmark.definition: At each origin, probability equals the mean y among all prior rows whose target_date is strictly earlier than that origin; fallback 0.5 if fewer than 20 matured outcomes exist.

block_eligibility_gate.selection_rule: Eligible blocks are determined only from E1/E2/E3 forward scores. No 2024Q4/2025/2026 information may influence eligibility.

candidate_construction.best_stable_block: Among eligible blocks, choose the block with the highest worst-environment Brier skill; ties broken by median AUC, then alphabetical block name. Fit once on all valid data through 2024-09-25.
candidate_construction.stable_equal_average: If at least two blocks are eligible, fit each eligible block once on all valid data through 2024-09-25 and average their probabilities equally. If exactly one block is eligible, this equals BEST_STABLE_BLOCK.
candidate_construction.if_no_eligible_blocks: NO_CANDIDATE; do not invent a new feature set or fit FOIL/IRM/anchor-regression after seeing scores.

bridge_gate.interpretation: 2024Q4 is the pre-2025 bridge check. 2025/2026 are reported only as retrospective diagnostics and cannot rescue a bridge failure.

visible_period_success_gate.use: Diagnostic persistence evidence only; not a fresh-OOS claim.

decision_lock.if_no_eligible_block: Reject current invariant-signal hypothesis and move to a separately justified information/target redesign or regime-similarity hypothesis.
decision_lock.if_eligible_but_bridge_fails: Do not escalate to invariant deep learning. Investigate regime-similarity weighting or new information under a new frozen contract.
decision_lock.if_bridge_passes_but_visible_persistence: Treat temporal invariance as insufficient; next study may test similar-regime weighting using only predeclared state distance and causal history.
decision_lock.if_bridge_and_visible_persistence_pass: Candidate may enter a separately frozen prospective-shadow design; no production promotion from V1.67.
